claims: gnd validate no longer refuses a fact type whose sample rows have a role named date or duration_days (issue 286).

The walk in src/gnd/terms.py does not read sample rows or an object type's description, and reads bind and head maps as containers keyed by role name, decided by the key that holds them; their values (a head's terms) are still read.
A date term in a derivation head under a role named source, provenance, bind or head is now refused, as under any other role name.
The 0.5.1 bump follows the tag-only procedure in docs/releasing.md, and the install pins keep naming 0.5.0.
The only behaviour change beyond the issue is that a date or duration_days object in a sample value or in a description extra no longer refuses a model, and the release notes say so.
